To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a broadband flip chip interconnection and an air cavity in a package base are suitable for the integration of a thin film antenna with an MMIC.
the antenna-in-package concept is feasible, that the antenna is well matched over a large bandwidth and that the flip chip interconnection does not significantly degrade the antenna performance.
the proposed antenna-in-package approach is feasible, that a broadband flip chip interconnection is possible and the influence of a cover on the performance of an antenna-in-package is negligible.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of a thin film antenna on a flexible polyimide substrate with flip chip interconnect and the realization of a package for an MMIC and an antenna in a single surface-mount package.
the design and realization of a 122-GHz antenna on a flexible polyimide substrate with flip chip interconnects.
the design, fabrication, and measurement of an antenna-in-package for the 122-GHz band, which is based on a flip chip assembly.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the antenna-in-package approach is a very promising technology for the integration of antennas with RFICs.
the presented antenna-in-package solution has a potential to be used in 60-GHz wireless communication systems.
a flip chip connection of a thin film antenna to an MMIC is feasible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully developed an integrated 122-GHz package for the integration of MMICs and antennas.
the presented antenna-in-package concept can be applied in the 122 GHz frequency range and that the package cover has a significant influence on the antenna performance.
we have developed a packaging technology for an integrated 122-GHz antenna with a flip chip interconnect and we demonstrated that this packaging solution is feasible for a surface-mountable package.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a flexible substrate can be used as a packaging substrate, and a flip chip interconnection can be realized between a MMIC and a flexible substrate.
the presented assembly process allows to integrate a broadband antenna with an MMIC on a single package.
a broadband antenna with a bandwidth of more than 20 GHz is achieved.
